none: PAS FindID 1008524: Lin-815574: Roman radiate of Tetricus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP C TETRIC]VS P F AVG ; R/ [SALVS AVGG]

A copper-alloy Roman radiate possibly of of Tetricus I (AD 271-274), dating to the period AD 271-274 (Reece period 13). [SALVS AVGG] reverse type depicting Salus standing left feeding snake rising from altar and holding rudder. Obverse description: Radiate, draped, and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C TETRIC]VS P F AVG. Reverse description: Salus standing left feeding snake rising from altar and holding rudder. Reverse inscription: [SALVS AVGG]. Dimensions: Diameter: 18.39 mm, Thickness: 2.11 mm, Weight: 2.44g
